risk_register.description: Seller backlash due to strict green claim keyword validation blocking eco-friendly seller claims
risk_register.closure_notes: Implemented clear seller guidance UI & rapid appeal path.
risk_register.mitigation_plan: Provide instant eco-label verification options in seller listing hub.

risk_register.description: Delayed EU Commission final technical specifications for durability notice icons
risk_register.mitigation_plan: Adopt draft harmonised notice specs with configurable frontend asset flags.

risk_register.description: Incomplete repairability score data provided by cross-border non-EU sellers
risk_register.mitigation_plan: Default to manufacturer catalog lookup where available.

decision_log.text: Enforce strict keyword blocking for climate neutral claims prior to Sept 2026
decision_log.context: Article 3(1)(b) prohibits unverified climate neutral claims. Delaying enforcement creates non-compliance liability.
decision_log.rationale: Minimizes regulatory risk while providing sellers 6 months grace period on warning state.

decision_log.text: Use EU Eco-Label registry API as primary verification source
decision_log.context: EU official registry provides real-time verification of valid environmental labels.
decision_log.rationale: Direct API validation avoids manual verification overhead.
